item.title: Qwen3.8-27B 可在本地运行前沿级编程智能体与推理任务，无需云端 API
item.summary: The biggest AI model release of the past few days, at least among the developers and AI power users on social media, wasn't a frontier cloud model from OpenAI, Anthropic or Google.
